# Dorothy

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Dorothy possesses roguish hazel eyes. Her appearance is otherwise noted to closely resemble [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), with her eye color serving as the primary distinction between them.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)_

## Personality

Dorothy Gardner is characterized by her slim build and a jolly, somewhat tomboyish demeanor. She is also known for her ardent and impulsive nature.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P32](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0032)_

## Traits

- impulsive  <sub>[v3 ch.B.A.’s P32](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0032)</sub>
- slim and jolly and rather tomboyish  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)</sub>

## History

Dorothy lived at Patty's Place with her housemates, who were delighted when Anne's story was accepted by a publisher. Her household was caught unprepared when Roy's mother and sisters arrived unexpectedly on a Friday instead of their planned Saturday visit, resulting in an awkward encounter involving rambunctious cats and a flattened chocolate cake. As college came to an end, Dorothy and the other girls at Patty's Place reflected on the lessons they had learned from their university experience.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--dorothy.md)

Dorothy is an intimate college friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their friendship is marked by shared social interactions, including an unexpected visit by Dorothy and her family to Anne's residence at Patty's Place that results in an awkward afternoon with misbehaving pets and ruined cake. They continue their close acquaintance through their final college examinations and graduation events.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), +7 more_

- Friend of — intimate college friends  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P32](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0032), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 ch.Weddings P4](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0004)</sub>

### [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dorothy--roy-gardner.md)

Dorothy is the sister of [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). She participates in family social calls alongside him and their mother, such as an unannounced Friday visit to Patty's Place. She is also present alongside her brother during the events surrounding his college graduation.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), +7 more_

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 ch.Weddings P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)</sub>
